# Paddle

> > Paddle is a comprehensive revenue engine for SaaS and app companies, offering subscription billing, global payments, tax compliance, and revenue analytics in a single platform.

Paddle provides an integrated suite of tools for monetizing digital products and subscriptions, including Paddle Billing for subscription management, ProfitWell Metrics for revenue analytics, and Retain for payment recovery. The platform serves SaaS companies, app developers, game studios, and digital product creators with global payment processing and automated tax compliance as a merchant of record.

## Key Topics

- Paddle Billing
- Subscription Management
- Payment Processing
- Tax Compliance
- Merchant of Record
- ProfitWell Metrics
- Retain (Dunning)
- Global Payments
- Fraud Protection
- Revenue Analytics
- SaaS Billing
- Chargeback Management
- API Integration
- Checkout Solutions
- Payment Recovery

## Core Platform

- [Paddle - Subscriptions, Payments & Tax for SaaS & Apps](https://www.paddle.com): Paddle revenue engine: subscription billing, payments, tax compliance
- [SaaS Billing Software | Recurring Billing for Subscriptions | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing): Paddle Billing: SaaS subscription management with tax compliance
- [SaaS & App Subscription Management Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing/subscriptions): Subscription management platform for SaaS with pricing flexibility
- [Payment Orchestration Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing/payments): Payment orchestration routing for global payment acceptance
- [Sales Tax Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing/tax-and-compliance): Automated sales tax, VAT, GST compliance with merchant of record

## Billing & Revenue Features

- [Invoicing Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing/invoicing): API-first invoicing with tax compliance and payment automation
- [Payment Fraud Protection Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/billing/fraud-protection): Fraud detection preventing card attacks and chargebacks
- [Subscription Analytics Software | Get Metrics For Free | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/profitwell-metrics): ProfitWell Metrics: free SaaS subscription analytics and revenue reporting
- [Dunning Software | Automated Dunning Management | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/retain): Retain: automated dunning management for failed payment recovery

## Industry Solutions

- [SaaS Billing Software | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/saas-billing): SaaS billing solution with global payments and tax compliance
- [Mobile App Monetization Platform | Sell Outside the App Store | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/web-stores): App monetization platform for web sales outside app stores
- [Sell Software Online Globally | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/sell-software-online): Global software sales platform with tax compliance automation
- [Sell Digital Products & Downloads Online | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/sell-digital-products): Digital product sales platform for courses, ebooks, games
- [Gaming Payment Solutions | Paddle](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/paddle-for-games): Gaming payment solution reducing app store fees globally
- [Paddle for app studios](https://www.paddle.com/solutions/app-studios): App studio solutions for multi-app portfolio monetization

## In-App & Alternative Payments
